2) How to count distinct domains (if you have the paper’s list of citation URLs)
- Decide whether you want to count distinct hostnames (including subdomains) or registered domains (example.com). Usually registered domains are used.
- Example Python snippet to get the number of unique registered domains from a list of URLs:

```python
# requires: pip install tldextract
import tldextract

urls = [
    "https://www.yelp.com/biz/example",
    "https://maps.google.com/?q=place",
    "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Example",
    # ... paste the URLs from the paper or dataset here ...
]

domains = set()
for u in urls:
    e = tldextract.extract(u)
    registered = ".".join(part for part in (e.domain, e.suffix) if part)
    domains.add(registered)

print("unique registered domains:", len(domains))
print(domains)
```
